name: CSS Sentinel
note: R13.28, Captain's Module R4 SSD p.68 (PDF p.69). The Destroyer turned escort, and the bigger sister of the FFE: one sheet carrying two ships, the DE here and the DEA in dea.json, differing only in year, price and aegis. NOTE THE DESIGNATIONS - the sheet says DE and DEA, not DDE and DDA. Validated box by box 2026-10-23 and EVERYTHING STRUCTURAL MATCHES THE PLAIN DD: shields 20 all round, C hull 10, warp 8 a side, impulse 2, APR 2, batteries 4, bridge 2, emergency 1, aux 1, transporters 2, tractors 2, labs 4, one probe launcher, crew 24 (two columns of ten and a partial four), boarding parties 8, turn mode B, and every damage track including the four excess-damage boxes. What the escort conversion adds is DECK CREWS 2 and READY RACKS, and what it changes is the armament: FOUR PLASMA-D RACKS - numbers 1 and 2 firing FH, 3 to port and 4 to starboard - where the DD carries two forward plasma-F launchers. THE SHUTTLE BLOCK IS G33.43'S OWN EXAMPLE DRAWN OUT: four boxes of which two are marked, which is exactly the 'escort with four shuttle boxes with two ready racks' the fighterFacilities javadoc quotes, so the admin shuttle count and the facility count are different numbers and both are recorded. SHEET NOTE: 'AS A CARRIER ESCORT, THIS SHIP HAS DECK CREWS AND READY RACKS TO SERVICE THE FIGHTERS OF THE CARRIER. IT HAS NO FIGHTERS OF ITS OWN', which is why the fighters block names a LINE and no counts. Aegis is on the hull from Y171, as on the FFE; the sheet's +0 Y175 refit is not modelled for the same reason it is not there either - with the aegis already on the hull it would change nothing, and a refit that changes nothing is refused. The Y180 Sabot refit (+4.5) is absent as elsewhere: FP11.0 is in Module R10, out of scope, and a half point will not fit an integer bpv.
